from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import hashlib,json,requests
P=Path.cwd();R=P/'reports/research/510300_electricity_nov2022_original_yoy_source_probe_v1'
u='https://jsdsm.fzggw.jiangsu.gov.cn/dsmsite/2jdxw/3145.jhtml'
q=R/'raw/government_repost_cec_nov2022.html'
if q.exists():raise RuntimeError('原页已收件，不重发')
(R/'raw').mkdir()
now=lambda:datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
registration={'selected_at':now(),'url':u,'selected_from':'登记两查询返回的江苏省发改委需求侧门户，中电联2022年1—11月完整全国通报','role':'OFFICIAL_GOVERNMENT_REPOST_SAME_ROOT_NOT_INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE','earlier_nea_known_original_not_requested':True,'new_source_root_origin_clock_unknown':True,'request_budget_at_most':2}
(R/'01_实际转载原对象_请求前绑定.json').write_text(json.dumps(registration,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
z={'url':u,'method':'GET','started_at':now(),'automatic_redirects':False,'retries':0,'authenticated':False}
try:
 with requests.Session() as sess:
  sess.trust_env=False
  a=sess.get(u,timeout=(10,25),allow_redirects=False,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; public historical research)','Accept':'text/html'})
  q.write_bytes(a.content)
  z.update({'received_at':now(),'http_status':a.status_code,'bytes':len(a.content),'raw_path':str(q.relative_to(P)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(a.content).hexdigest(),'content_type':a.headers.get('Content-Type'),'response_date':a.headers.get('Date'),'redirect_location':a.headers.get('Location')})
except Exception as e:z.update({'received_at':now(),'http_status':None,'bytes':0,'error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)})
(R/'request_ledger.json').write_text(json.dumps([z],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(z,ensure_ascii=False))
if z.get('http_status')==200:
 s=BeautifulSoup(q.read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 for a in s.find_all(['script','style']):a.decompose()
 text=s.get_text('\n',strip=True)
 (R/'实际转载全文_未补首版.txt').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
 print('头部',text[:1300])
 print('相关原链接',[(a.get_text(' ',strip=True)[:70],a['href']) for a in s.find_all('a',href=True) if 'cec' in a['href'] or '2022年1-11' in a.get_text() or '电力工业' in a.get_text()])
 print('正文候选',[(a.name,a.get('id'),a.get('class'),len(a.get_text())) for a in s.find_all(['div','article']) if '同比下降1.0%' in a.get_text() and len(a.get_text())<15000][:12])
